mapper.select: SELECT t.type_id, t.type_name, COUNT(b.book_id) AS book_count FROM book_type t LEFT JOIN book b ON t.type_id = b.type_id GROUP BY t.type_id, t.type_name ORDER BY book_count DESC, t.type_id

SELECT br.borrow_id, br.user_id, u.user_no, u.user_name, br.book_id, b.book_name, b.isbn, br.borrow_time, br.due_return_time, br.actual_return_time, br.borrow_status, CASE br.borrow_status WHEN 0 THEN 'not_returned' WHEN 1 THEN 'returned' WHEN 2 THEN 'overdue' END AS borrow_status_text, DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, DATE(br.due_return_time)) AS overdue_days FROM borrow_record br JOIN sys_user u ON br.user_id = u.user_id JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.book_id WHERE br.borrow_status IN (0, 2) AND br.actual_return_time IS NULL AND br.due_return_time < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY overdue_days DESC, br.due_return_time

SELECT t.type_id, t.type_name, COUNT(br.borrow_id) AS borrow_count FROM borrow_record br JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.book_id JOIN book_type t ON b.type_id = t.type_id GROUP BY t.type_id, t.type_name ORDER BY borrow_count DESC, t.type_id
